verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents a public REST/gRPC API for CKS clusters and Inference (create/list/update/delete), Bearer-token auth, generated clients in multiple languages, and a Terraform provider for IaC control — and a live runtime probe confirms the CKS API endpoint is reachable and Bearer-gated exactly as documented. missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on API usage reports/tutorials beyond CoreWeave's own docs.
